credits.title: Are We Happy?
credits.overview: At their daughter’s request, a divorced couple finds themselves forced to go on vacation together, pretending they are still married. This charade of happiness compels them to confront their past and the mistakes they made while raising their child.

credits.title: Yasemin Sakallıoğlu - Doğru Koca Nasıl Seçilir?
We Are Happy
credits.overview: Close friends Ferhat and Aslı realize that they need to be together after they are abandoned by their lovers. In the third year of their marriage, things are no longer going well. Ferhat tells Aslı that they are going on vacation and takes Aslı to a hotel for couples therapy, hoping to improve their relationship.

credits.title: Zengo
credits.overview: A housewife with a big passion for fashion and with the help of her tailor Fazilet, she is turning her ideas into reality, but she gets competition from her school day friend and rival Menkibe.
